title: TANKER VOYAGE CHARTER
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.MSC.MSC HQS.MSCHQ NORFOLK
detail_text: Action Code: Presolicitation Date: 26 March 2026 Fiscal Year: 2026 Contracting Office Zip Code: 23511 Product or Service Code: V124 - Transportation/Travel/Relocation - Transportation: Marine Charter Contracting Office Address: 471 East C Street, Naval Station Norfolk, Norfolk, VA 23511 Subject: Tanker Voyage Charter Proposed Solicitation Number: N3220526R6069 Closing Response Date: Thursday, 02 April 2026 Contract Point of Contact: David Hamilton, david.k.hamilton19.civ@us.navy.mil; 564-230-3260 and Michelle James, michelle.d.james7.civ@us.navy.mil, 564-230-3323 Contract Award and Solicitation Number: TBD Contract Award Dollar Amount: TBD Contract Line Item Number: N/A Contract Award Date: TBA Contractor: TBD Description: One, clean, approved, U.S. or foreign flag, double-hull tanker, with an inert gas system or equivalent (e.g. nitrogen generation system) and segregated ballast tanks that is capable of carrying a minimum of 15,000 bbls of clean product (intentions JPTS) within vessel’s natural segregation in designated cargo tanks with double valve isolation. Place of Contract Performance: The intended loading port/place is Killingholme, U.K. (SKJ Terminal); and the intended discharge port/place is Akrotiri, Cyprus (PSD-RAF Akrotiri Terminal). The laydays commence 02 May and cancel 09 May 2026, and the period of performance is one voyage. Set-aside Status: N/A. The decision to release this procurement as “Unrestricted” is based on the Contracting Officer’s knowledge of the market and applicable market research. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. The MSC Director of Small Business Programs concurred with this decision.
